# The world-economy feed

World economy (IMF forecasts, UNDP, CIA World Factbook, World Bank governance indicators).

Forecasts and fiscal figures of every country (IMF World Economic Outlook), human development (UNDP), governance (World Bank WGI) and jurisdictions, parties, office holders and elections (CIA World Factbook). The World Bank's development indicators (WDI) come from the world-development feed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | IMF, UNDP, CIA World Factbook, World Bank (WGI) (https://data.worldbank.org) |
| Licence | [World Bank CC BY 4.0; IMF terms (no commercial reuse without permission); UNDP CC BY 3.0 IGO; Factbook public domain](https://www.imf.org/en/About/copyright-and-terms): **internal only** |
| Attribution | World Bank World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0); IMF World Economic Outlook; UNDP Human Development Reports; CIA World Factbook |
| Notes | internal only because of the IMF forecasts; a build with -- --no-imf carries only redistributable data |
| Lake | `worldlake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 06:45 (local time) |
| Pull | `world_economy.WorldEconomyFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/world_economy.py); 0.4 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run world-economy --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run world-economy                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/, load into worldlake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status world-economy             # its last runs
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run world-economy --snapshot     # refresh the committed demo snapshot instead (with --internal-ok)
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [EXTERNAL_DATA.md](../../docs/guides/EXTERNAL_DATA.md).

## Data contract

### region-economy

Pack `world-economy`, kind `region-economy` (Region economy), table `region-economy`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/region-economy.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REGION_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The state or territory. |
| `REGION_CODE` | text | required | The ISO 3166-2 code of the region (AU-NSW, US-CA); the BI map shades the region it names. |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The country the region belongs to. |
| `YEAR` | text | required | The year of the figures. |
| `POPULATION_M` | amount | required | People living in the region, rounded to the nearest 10,000 and shown in millions. Illustrative. |
| `POPULATION` | integer | required | Population, rounded to the nearest 10,000. |
| `GDP_USD_BN` | amount | required | The region's output in US dollars, rounded to the nearest billion. Illustrative, not for reporting. |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | integer | required | GDP over population, in US dollars. Illustrative. |
| `SOURCE` | text | required | Where the figures come from; they are illustrative, rounded from public figures, not for reporting. |
| `FACTS` | record | required | How the figures were made, one object: STATUS (illustrative, rounded, not for reporting), REGION_CODE (ISO 3166-2), POPULATION and GDP (the rounding applied). |
| `ECONOMY` | id | required | The country the region belongs to: an id of the economy kind (ECON-AUS, ECON-USA). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the figures come from, one object: SOURCE (the statistics office publications they were rounded from), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"REGION_ID": "REGE-AU-ACT", "NAME": "Australian Capital Territory", "REGION_CODE": "AU-ACT", "ISO3": "AUS", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Australia", "YEAR": "2023", "POPULATION_M": 0.46, "POPULATION": 460000, "GDP_USD_BN": 33, "GDP_PER_CAPITA": 71739, "SOURCE": "Illustrative, rounded from public figures (ABS Australian D…", "ECONOMY": "ECON-AUS"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/region-economy.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### jurisdiction

Pack `world-economy`, kind `jurisdiction` (Jurisdiction), table `jurisdiction`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/jurisdiction.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `JURISDICTION_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The country's common name. |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. |
| `OFFICIAL_NAME` | text | required | The country's official long name (CIA World Factbook). |
| `CAPITAL` | text | optional | The seat of government. |
| `REGION_NAME` | text | required | The World Bank region the country is in. |
| `POPULATION_M` | amount | required | The number of residents (World Bank, mid-year). |
| `AREA_KM2` | amount | optional | Total area, land and water. |
| `GOVERNMENT_TYPE` | text | optional | The form of government, as the CIA World Factbook describes it. |
| `CURRENCY` | text | optional | The ISO 4217 code of the currency, from the Factbook exchange-rate entry. |
| `INDEPENDENCE` | text | optional | Independence, as the CIA World Factbook writes it. |
| `LEGISLATURE_NAME` | text | optional | The legislature's name as the World Factbook gives it, with its local name in brackets (Legislature (Staten)). |
| `LEGISLATURE_STRUCTURE` | text | optional | unicameral (one chamber) or bicameral (two), from the World Factbook. |
| `LEGISLATURE` | record list | required | The seats by party in the lower (or only) chamber after its latest election, one element per party: PARTY and SEATS; empty when the Factbook gives none. |
| `INDICATORS` | record list | required | The country's headline social and governance indicators, one element each: INDICATOR, VALUE, YEAR (text) and UNIT (years, index 0-1, % of population …). |
| `PARTIES_LISTED` | record list | required | The political parties the World Factbook lists for the country, one element each: PARTY (the name, or the Factbook's sentence when there are none). |
| `PROFILE` | record | required | The country's profile from the World Factbook, one object of published text: OFFICIAL_NAME, LOCATION, INDEPENDENCE, NATIONAL_HOLIDAY, LEGAL_SYSTEM, SUFFRAGE, LANGUAGES, RELIGIONS and CURRENCY_TEXT. |
| `REGION` | id | required | The country's World Bank region: an id of the region kind (REGN-<World Bank region code>, REGN-LCN). |
| `CHIEF_OF_STATE` | id | optional | The chief of state: an id of the office-holder kind (OFFC-<ISO3>-COS). |
| `HEAD_OF_GOVERNMENT` | id | optional | The head of government: an id of the office-holder kind (OFFC-<ISO3>-HOG). |
| `LAST_ELECTION` | id | optional | The latest legislative election: an id of the election kind (ELEC-<ISO3>-LOW for the lower or only chamber). |
| `ELECTIONS` | id list | required | The country's elections: ids of the election kind (ELEC-<ISO3>-EXE for the executive, -LOW and -UPP for the lower and upper chambers). |
| `PARTIES` | id list | required | The parties that won seats at the latest election: ids of the party kind (PARTY-<ISO3>-<nn>); empty when none. |
| `SOCIAL_INDICATORS` | id list | required | The country's social indicators: ids of the social-indicator kind (SOCI-<ISO3>-<indicator>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Factbook, World Bank WDI and WGI, UNDP), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"JURISDICTION_ID": "JUR-ABW", "NAME": "Aruba", "ISO3": "ABW", "OFFICIAL_NAME": "Country of Aruba", "CAPITAL": "Oranjestad", "REGION_NAME": "Latin America & Caribbean", "POPULATION_M": 0.108785, "AREA_KM2": 180.0, "GOVERNMENT_TYPE": "parliamentary democracy; part of the Kingdom of the Netherl…", "CURRENCY": "AFA", "INDEPENDENCE": "none (part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands)", "LEGISLATURE_NAME": "Legislature (Staten)", "LEGISLATURE_STRUCTURE": "unicameral", "REGION": "REGN-LCN", "CHIEF_OF_STATE": "OFFC-ABW-COS", "HEAD_OF_GOVERNMENT": "OFFC-ABW-HOG", "LAST_ELECTION": "ELEC-ARG-LOW"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/jurisdiction.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### party

Pack `world-economy`, kind `party` (Party), table `party`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/party.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PARTY_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | optional | The party's name as the CIA World Factbook lists it in the election result. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The country the party competes in. |
| `SEATS` | integer | required | The seats the party won in the chamber at the most recent election. |
| `SEAT_SHARE` | rate | required | The party's seats as a share of the seats the Factbook lists. |
| `CHAMBER` | text | required | The legislative chamber the result is for. |
| `RANK` | integer | required | The party's rank by seats won in the chamber (1 = most). |
| `TOTAL_SEATS` | amount | required | The total seats in the chamber. |
| `ELECTION_DATE` | text | required | When the most recent election was held, as published. |
| `RESULTS` | record list | required | The whole election's seats by party, one element per party: PARTY, SEATS and SHARE (% of seats). |
| `ELECTION` | id | required | The election the party won seats at: an id of the election kind (ELEC-<ISO3>-LOW). |
| `JURISDICTION` | id | required | The party's country: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (CIA World Factbook), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"PARTY_ID": "PARTY-ARG-01", "NAME": "Union for the Homeland (UP)", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Argentina", "SEATS": 48, "SEAT_SHARE": 37.5, "CHAMBER": "Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)", "RANK": 1, "TOTAL_SEATS": 128, "ELECTION_DATE": "10/22/2023", "ELECTION": "ELEC-ARG-LOW", "JURISDICTION": "JUR-ARG"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/party.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### office-holder

Pack `world-economy`, kind `office-holder` (Office holder), table `office-holder`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/office-holder.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OFFICE_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The country the office belongs to. |
| `ROLE` | text | required | Chief of state (the ceremonial or constitutional head) or head of government (who leads the executive). |
| `HOLDER` | text | required | The title and name of the office holder as the Factbook publishes them; surnames are in capitals. |
| `SINCE` | text | optional | The date the holder took office, as published. |
| `PUBLISHED` | text | required | The office holder as the CIA World Factbook writes it. |
| `PROCESS` | text | optional | How the office is filled, as published. |
| `ELECTION_HELD` | text | optional | When the last election was held, as published text. |
| `NEXT_ELECTION` | text | optional | When the next election is due, as published text. |
| `RESULTS` | text | optional | The last election's result, as published. |
| `GOVERNMENT_TYPE` | text | required | The form of government. |
| `CABINET` | text | optional | How the cabinet is formed, as published. |
| `JURISDICTION` | id | required | The country of the office: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (CIA World Factbook), DATASET (the mirror commit), RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |
| `MANDATE` | record | required | How the office is filled, one object of World Factbook text: SELECTION, HELD_ON, NEXT_ELECTION, RESULTS, CABINET and AS_PUBLISHED. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"OFFICE_ID": "OFFC-ABW-COS", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Aruba", "ROLE": "Chief of state", "HOLDER": "King WILLEM-ALEXANDER of the Netherlands; represented by Go…", "SINCE": "30 April 2013", "PUBLISHED": "King WILLEM-ALEXANDER of the Netherlands (since 30 April 20…", "PROCESS": "the monarchy is hereditary; governor general appointed by t…", "ELECTION_HELD": "6 December 2024", "NEXT_ELECTION": "by December 2028", "RESULTS": "Mike EMAN (AVP) elected prime minister; percent of Staten v…", "GOVERNMENT_TYPE": "parliamentary democracy; part of the Kingdom of the Netherl…", "CABINET": "Council of Ministers elected by the Legislature (Staten)", "JURISDICTION": "JUR-ABW"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/office-holder.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### election

Pack `world-economy`, kind `election` (Election), table `election`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/election.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ELECTION_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `TITLE` | text | required | The country and the chamber or office. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The country's name as the World Factbook gives it (Aruba). |
| `CHAMBER` | text | required | The chamber or office elected (Executive, or the chamber's name). |
| `DATE` | date | optional | The election date (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `DATE_TEXT` | text | optional | When the most recent election took place, as the Factbook publishes the date. |
| `SYSTEM` | text | optional | The electoral system, for example plurality, proportional representation or an electoral college. |
| `TERM` | text | optional | The term of office, as published (for example 4 years). |
| `WINNER` | text | optional | The party with the most seats, or the elected head of state. |
| `NEXT_ELECTION` | text | optional | When the next election is expected, as published. |
| `WOMEN` | text | optional | The share of seats held by women, as published text (for example 42.4%). |
| `SEATS_TEXT` | text | optional | The chamber's seats as the CIA World Factbook publishes them. |
| `RESULTS` | record list | required | The seats won by party at the election, one element per party: PARTY, SEATS and SHARE (% of seats); empty for an executive election or when the Factbook gives none. |
| `SUMMARY` | record | required | The election in brief, one object from the World Factbook: SELECTION (how the body is chosen), HELD_ON, NEXT_ELECTION, CHAMBER, ELECTORAL_SYSTEM, SEATS, TERM, WOMEN and RESULTS (all as published text). |
| `JURISDICTION` | id | required | The country the election is in: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (CIA World Factbook), DATASET (the mirror commit), RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"ELECTION_ID": "ELEC-ABW-EXE", "TITLE": "Aruba · executive (head of state)", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Aruba", "CHAMBER": "Executive", "DATE": "2024-12-06", "DATE_TEXT": "6 December 2024", "SYSTEM": "the monarchy is hereditary; governor general appointed by t…", "TERM": "4 years", "WINNER": "King WILLEM-ALEXANDER of the Netherlands; represented by Go…", "NEXT_ELECTION": "by December 2028", "WOMEN": "42.4%", "SEATS_TEXT": "257 (all directly elected)", "JURISDICTION": "JUR-ABW"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/election.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### region

Pack `world-economy`, kind `region` (World region), table `region`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/region.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REGION_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | A World Bank geographic region. |
| `COUNTRIES` | integer | required | The number of countries of the region in the pack. |
| `POPULATION_M` | amount | required | The region's total population (World Bank aggregate). |
| `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` | amount | required | Years a newborn would live at current mortality (World Bank aggregate). |
| `YEAR` | text | required | The year of the figures. |
| `INTERNET` | amount | required | The share of the population that used the Internet in the last three months. |
| `WOMEN_PARLIAMENT` | amount | required | The share of parliamentary seats held by women (Inter-Parliamentary Union, via the World Bank). |
| `URBAN` | amount | required | Urban population as a share of the total (World Bank). |
| `LIFE_TREND` | record list | required | Life expectancy at birth across the region by year, one element per year: YEAR and VALUE in years (World Bank). |
| `INTERNET_TREND` | record list | required | Internet use across the region by year, one element per year: YEAR and VALUE in % of population (World Bank). |
| `GOVERNMENT_TYPES` | record list | required | How many member countries have each form of government, one element per type: TYPE (World Factbook wording) and COUNT. |
| `MEMBER_STATES` | id list | required | The region's countries: ids of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI, CIA World Factbook), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"REGION_ID": "REGN-EAS", "NAME": "East Asia & Pacific", "COUNTRIES": 37, "POPULATION_M": 2390.87, "LIFE_EXPECTANCY": 76.7379, "YEAR": "2024", "INTERNET": 88.4, "WOMEN_PARLIAMENT": 23.3498, "URBAN": 64.771}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/region.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).

### social-indicator

Pack `world-economy`, kind `social-indicator` (Social indicator), table `social-indicator`; files `data/datafeeds/world-economy/<date>/social-indicator.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INDICATOR_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The country and the statistic. |
| `INDICATOR` | text | required | The indicator's name as published (Government expenditure on education). |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The country's name (Aruba). |
| `THEME` | text | required | The theme of the indicator (Society or Governance). |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The most recent published value. |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | text | required | The year of the latest value. |
| `UNIT` | text | required | What the value measures. |
| `CHANGE_5Y` | amount | optional | The latest value minus the value about five years earlier. |
| `SOURCE_NAME` | text | required | The dataset the series comes from. |
| `DEFINITION` | text | required | The source's definition of the indicator. |
| `SERIES` | record list | required | The indicator by year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR (text) and VALUE in the unit of MEANING.UNIT. |
| `BY_REGION` | record list | required | The latest value for the countries of the same region, one element per country: COUNTRY (its name) and VALUE. |
| `REGION_NAME` | text | required | The World Bank region of the country, for the regional comparison. |
| `JURISDICTION` | id | required | The country: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI or WGI, or UNDP), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. |
| `MEANING` | record | required | What the indicator means, one object: INDICATOR, UNIT (% of GDP, births per woman …), DEFINITION and COMPARED_WITH (the region the country is compared with). |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"INDICATOR_ID": "SOCI-ABW-EDUCATION-SPEND", "NAME": "Aruba · Government expenditure on education", "INDICATOR": "Government expenditure on education", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Aruba", "THEME": "Society", "LATEST": 3.61856, "LATEST_YEAR": "2021", "UNIT": "% of GDP", "CHANGE_5Y": -1.8728, "SOURCE_NAME": "World Bank, World Development Indicators", "DEFINITION": "General government spending on education, as a share of GDP.", "REGION_NAME": "Latin America & Caribbean", "JURISDICTION": "JUR-ABW"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/world-economy/contracts/social-indicator.contract.yaml` ([world-economy](../../docs/contracts/packs/world-economy.md)).
